policy.responder_fraction: Convert a count numerator over a stated denominator to fraction using a deterministic 50-digit decimal expansion of 1/N.
policy.bounded_scale: Keep bounded scores, grades, and indices on their reported scales.
policy.mixed_or_ambiguous: Keep an exact endpoint/unit key unchanged when its rows do not share one numerical meaning.
policy.runtime_contract: Reviewed decisions are encoded only in the existing exact endpoint/unit map; no row-level heuristic runs during normalization.
